title: What Can You Do in Funchal on a Sunday?
description: The market and many small shops close, but the Monte cable car, gardens, big shopping centres and old town cafés stay open, and boat trips run as usual.
heroAlt: A quiet Sunday morning on Rua de Santa Maria in Funchal's old town with painted doors
keywords: things to do in funchal on a sunday
what is open in funchal on sunday
is the market in funchal open on sunday

images.prompt: Early Sunday morning on Rua de Santa Maria in the Zona Velha, Funchal's old town. A narrow cobbled street with colourfully painted wooden doors on both sides, most shop shutters still closed, one small café setting out two little tables in the street. A single person seen from behind walks away down the street carrying a paper bag of bread. Soft low light, long shadows, true colours, no readable signs or text, no faces.
images.alt: A quiet Sunday morning on Rua de Santa Maria in Funchal's old town with painted doors
